title: Does not maintain temp, even after prep
text: Does not maintain temp, even after prep. These are really cute and convenient.  I wanted and expected to love them, especially after the great reviews.  However, they don't keep hot foods hot and cold foods cold for up to 3.5 hours, which is what I need for my child's lunch.  I followed the directions for prepping them to sustain temp and after 3 days of trials, I can firmly say they just don't.  Now I have 4 spill proof containers that maintain things at room temp.  Not great.
